description: This file provides utility functions for handling file system paths in a cross-platform manner within a VS Code extension, including path normalization, comparison, and workspace path retrieval.

methods.name: toPosixPath
methods.description: Converts Windows-style paths with backslashes to POSIX-style paths with forward slashes, handling extended-length paths.

methods.name: String.prototype.toPosix
methods.description: Adds a method to the String prototype to convert paths to POSIX format.

methods.name: arePathsEqual
methods.description: Compares two paths for equality in a platform-independent manner, normalizing and case-insensitive on Windows.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path by resolving segments and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: getReadablePath
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly path string, either absolute, relative, or basename depending on context.

methods.name: toRelativePath
methods.description: Converts a file path to a relative path from the given current working directory.

methods.name: getWorkspacePath
methods.description: Retrieves the current workspace folder path, defaulting to a provided path if none is open.

methods.name: getWorkspacePathForContext
methods.description: Finds the workspace folder for a given context path, or falls back to the current workspace.
